لطلمبة التعويض وهى 
الطلمبة المسئولة عن تعويض ضغط المياة داخل خطوط اطفاء الحريق إذا وصل الضغط داخل الخطوط إلى 9 
بار وعددها 1 
طلمبة

أعد المسودة الأولية المهندس/أحمد 
محمد المهتدى قمرة وإختبرها المهندس/عبد المجيد الحناوى 
وراجعها المهندس/السعيد شعبان عبد القادر والمهندس/حسام الريفى ووافق عليها السيد المهندس/ مجدى عقبة: مدير عام صيانة الغلايات 
واعتمدها السيد المهندس/ أحمد عبد المجيد صوان: 
رئيس قطاع محطة توليد كهرباء النوبارية.

راجعها ووافق على المستند المهندس/ 
سمير عبد الجليل: مدير عام التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة وسط الدلتا لإنتاج الكهرباء 
ومنسق الشركة لنظام معلومات إجراءات الصيانة ووثق من السيد المهندس/محمد نجيب عبد الحى: رئيس قطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة 
بشركة وسط الدلتا لإنتاج الكهرباء 
.

sections_en.text: This document outlines the half-yearly maintenance steps I2, M6, for the make-up pump, which is the pump responsible for making up the water pressure inside the fire-fighting lines if the pressure inside the lines reaches 9 bar; there is 1 pump.

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Henawy, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader and Eng. Hossam El-Rify, accepted by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.

The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.

items: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment.

Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs.
Wear personal protective equipment ( safety helmet, safety shoes , overalls, gloves ..... ).
Isolate the pump electrically and mechanically.
Close the suction and discharge valves.

Introduction
This document outlines the half-yearly maintenance steps I2, M6, for the make-up pump, which is the pump responsible for making up the water pressure inside the fire-fighting lines if the pressure inside the lines reaches 9 bar; there is 1 pump.

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Meguid El-Henawy, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader and Eng. Hossam El-Rify, accepted by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.
The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment.
Those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card.
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs.
Wear personal protective equipment ( safety helmet, safety shoes , overalls, gloves ..... ).
Isolate the pump electrically and mechanically.
Close the suction and discharge valves.
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Complete tool bag
Pump-specific tools
Procedures to be Carried Out
1. | Inspect the 
 Pressure Indicator
 on the 
 Fire line.
2. | Check the pressure from the 
 Display 
on the pump.
3. | Inspect the alarms from the auxiliary control panel and the main control panel.
4. | Test the 
 Pressure Switch
 inside the pump control panel.
5. | Maintain the 
 Pressure Indicator 
 or replace it if it is damaged.
6. | Maintain or replace the 
 Pressure Switch 
 inside the pump control panel if it is damaged.
7. | Inspect the suction and discharge lines.
8. | Make sure there is no sound from the motor.
9. | Inspect vibrations and remedy them.
10. | Check any leaks and remedy them.
11. | Make sure the electrical connections are sound.
12. | Check general cleanliness.
